text:
Maya: Quick design review request — two usability pains in autoscale UI: (1) min/max stepper is ambiguous (users think it only affects the selected pool) and (2) pool search suggestions vanish while typing when there are lots of pools. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/autoscale-v2

Ken: Saw this in testing. One user increased min thinking it was per-pool. We need clearer scope and maybe a confirmation for cluster-wide changes.

Sasha: Copy idea: show "Min capacity (cluster)" or keep compact label + info icon with accessible tooltip explaining scope. Tooltip text should read: "Applies to all selected pools unless you pick a single pool."

Jamal: Prefer tooltip for tight layouts. Also accessibility: stepper changes aren't announced on keyboard hold — add aria-live announcements like "Min capacity set to X GPUs" and debounce to avoid spam.

design-bot: Contrast alert: stepper value color fails AA. Recommend darker text color or semibold weight.

Ken: Pool search bug: when >100 pools we debounce queries but clear suggestions immediately. Option A: keep last results until new ones arrive; Option B: client-side prefix filter of cached page plus remote search. I vote A for less jank.

Sasha: Also show a contextual CTA when no pool matches: "Request pool" or "Create pool" depending on role. Prevents dead ends.

Maya: For the SLO slider, ensure arrow keys change by 1%, PageUp/PageDown by 10%, and add an aria-describedby live summary: "SLO set to 98% — est. throughput impact +8% latency." Synthesize from model profile.

Jamal: I'll implement aria-live announce on slider commit using the announce util and debounce. Pseudo: announce(`SLO set to ${value}% — est. cost ${delta}%`, {politeness: 'polite'});

Sasha: Burst toggle microcopy: instead of "Allow burst" try "Enable temporary burst capacity" with subtext "Automatically scales above max for short windows." Move toggle to right edge on mobile to avoid accidental taps.

Ken: Add a confirmation toast when burst is enabled with link: "View estimated monthly cost." Many forget it's on.

Maya: I'll add these items to a PR checklist (roles, aria-live, aria-describedby, keyboard nav, contrast, touch targets). Opening a ticket now and assigning owners.

design-bot: Created ticket REDWOOD-1428 — Autoscale: clarify min/max scope, pool search persistence, burst microcopy & a11y. https://tracker.example.com/REDWOOD-1428

Ken: I'll take pool search fix (small patch tomorrow).

Sasha: I'll prototype copy and placement today.

Jamal: I'll do the aria-live+stepper announcements.
